overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.description: The tournament feature allows you to create and manage team-based tournaments. Here's the typical flow:

steps.step1: Organizer creates and publishes a tournament
steps.step2: Teams apply during the registration period
steps.step3: After registration closes, organizer runs the lottery
steps.step4: Selected teams are finalized and the tournament begins

create.title: 2. Creating a Tournament
create.description: After logging in, go to "Tournaments" → "Create" to create a new tournament.

steps.step1: Enter basic info (name, description, event dates)

create.draftNote: Note: Draft tournaments don't accept applications. Publish when ready.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.public: Public: Visible and open to all users
visibility.circle: Circle Only: Limited to specified circle members

period.title: Registration Period
period.description: Set start and end dates. Teams can only apply within this period.

teamCount.title: Team Limits
teamCount.maxTeams: Max Teams: Maximum number of participating teams. Excess applications go through lottery
teamCount.memberCount: Member Count: Min-max members per team

lottery.title: Lottery Method
lottery.firstCome: First Come, First Served: Select in order of application

rating.title: Rating Requirements
rating.min: Average Above: Team average rating must be above specified value
rating.max: Average Below: Team average rating must be below specified value

contact.title: Required Contacts
contact.description: Set minimum number of team members who must share contact info. Teams designate these members when applying.

rules.title: Rules & Regulations
rules.description: Write tournament rules and regulations. Applicants can view these on the tournament detail page.

registration.title: 4. Team Registration
registration.description: Members with scrim permissions (admin or scrim manager) can apply on behalf of their team.
registration.singleNote: Note: Each team can only apply once per tournament.

preSelection.title: Pre-Lottery Actions
preSelection.description: After registration closes, organizers can mark applications as "Select" or "Reject" before the lottery. Marked teams are excluded from the random selection.

runLottery.title: Running the Lottery
runLottery.description: Click "Run Lottery" to determine winners among unmarked applicants using the configured method (random/first-come). Excess applicants are placed on the waitlist with rankings.

promote.title: Promoting Reserves
promote.description: If a selected team withdraws, use "Promote Reserve" to move the first waitlisted team to selected status.

disqualify.title: Disqualification
disqualify.description: You can disqualify selected teams for rule violations or other reasons.

dateExclusion.title: Date-specific Team Settings
dateExclusion.description: For multi-day events (qualifiers, finals, etc.), you can exclude eliminated teams from later dates. Excluded teams won't receive reminder notifications for those dates.

additional.title: 6. Additional Recruitment
additional.description: If you need more teams after the lottery, you can open additional recruitment.

howTo.title: How to Start
howTo.step1: Go to the "Manage" tab and click "Start Additional Recruitment"
howTo.step2: Teams can apply directly from the tournament detail page

additional.note: Note: Click "Stop Additional Recruitment" when you have enough teams.

coOrganizer.title: 7. Co-organizers
coOrganizer.description: Share tournament management responsibilities with other users.
coOrganizer.applyDescription: Click "Apply as Co-organizer" on the tournament detail page. The organizer must approve your application.
coOrganizer.manageDescription: Organizers can approve or reject co-organizer applications in the "Manage" tab. They can also remove approved co-organizers.

challonge.title: 8. Challonge Integration
challonge.description: After the lottery, automatically create brackets on Challonge with selected teams.
challonge.authDescription: To use Challonge integration, log in with your Challonge account. Click "Login to Challonge" and complete authentication in the popup. Authentication is only kept for the current session and clears when you close the page.

formats.single: Single Elimination: One loss and you're out
formats.double: Double Elimination: Two losses and you're out

grandFinalsOptions.normal: Normal (with reset): If losers bracket winner wins, a reset match occurs
grandFinalsOptions.single: Single match only (OWCS style): Grand Finals decided in one match
grandFinalsOptions.skip: Skip Grand Finals: No final match between winners and losers bracket champions

twoStage.title: 9. Two-Stage Tournaments
twoStage.description: Create tournaments with Group Stage → Finals format.

steps.step1Desc: Divide teams into groups and create round robin for each
steps.step3Desc: After groups complete, fetch standings to see advancing teams
steps.step4Desc: Create elimination bracket with advancing teams

settings.advancingCount: Teams per Group Advancing: Choose 1-4 teams

twoStage.example: Example: 16 teams, 4 groups, 2 advancing each → 8 teams in finals
twoStage.hintDescription: Teams are randomly assigned to groups. You can fetch standings before groups complete, but teams without final rankings won't be included in advancing teams.

cancelRegistration.q: How do I cancel my team's application?
cancelRegistration.a: Teams can cancel anytime before the lottery runs. Go to the tournament detail page and click "Cancel Registration".

cancelTournament.q: How do I cancel a tournament?
cancelTournament.a: Go to the "Manage" tab and click "Cancel Tournament". This action cannot be undone.

coOrganizerFaq.a: Yes, users can apply to be co-organizers from the tournament page. You can approve applications in the Manage tab.

deleteChallonge.q: How do I delete a Challonge tournament?
deleteChallonge.a: Delete it directly from Challonge's website. This system cannot delete Challonge tournaments.

csvExport.q: What's included in the CSV export?
csvExport.a: Team name, rating info, member details, contacts, and messages. Discord IDs and BattleTags of designated contact persons are included.

multipleApplications.q: Can I apply with multiple teams?
multipleApplications.a: Yes, you can apply with different teams you belong to. However, the same team cannot apply multiple times to the same tournament.

afterLottery.q: How do I add teams after the lottery?
afterLottery.a: Use the "Additional Recruitment" feature or manually add teams. Added teams are immediately accepted.
